note: ambiguous NAV-01: rule names dropdown_menu/dropdown_item but not close-on-outside-click or close-on-link behaviour; no Escape handling, native <details> summary still toggles from the keyboard.

Guide: approved spinners must honour prefers-reduced-motion. Code: "Searching…" row builds an animate-spin icon with no reduced-motion override (none in accessibility.css or autocomplete.css). ac-* classes otherwise follow AC-01.
Guide: times use a 24-hour clock. Code: toLocaleString with hour "2-digit" and no hourCycle, so an en-US browser shows a 12-hour clock with AM/PM on the kiosk page.

Guide: everything works from the keyboard; tabs come from tab_navigation (TABS-01). Code: hand-rolled Upload/Camera tabs set tabIndex -1 on the idle tab with no arrow-key handler, so "Take Selfie" is unreachable by Tab.
pattern=modals Guide: confirmations use the app's dialog (confirm_modal). Code: confirmChecked asks with native window.confirm; used for permission grants by membership-editor and permission-editor.
Guide: an empty value prints "—". Code: the state select's blank option is "-" (lines 62, 80). Also dims the label with opacity-60 for a disabled field, which no rule covers.

Guide: confirms use the app dialog and ask "<Verb> <thing>?". Code: leave guards via window.confirm ("It looks like a shift was not started. Leave this page anyway?"). Also animate-pulse on a checklist chip (line 236), not a badge.
ambiguous FORM-04: guide shows input_counter_data usage only; the "N of MAX characters" div is not tied to the field by aria-describedby and is not a live region.

Guide: confirm in the app dialog, asking with the action and saying if it can be undone. Code: multi-paragraph window.confirm texts ("Grant this position anyway?", "Make them a Clubhouse Manager anyway?") via confirm_checkbox.

Guide: confirm in the app dialog with "<Verb> <thing>?" plus whether it can be undone. Code: native confirm() on submit, opening "WARNING: <titles> require prior approval…", and window.confirm on toggle (line 29).

Guide: inline notices are ui_callout_box. Code: window.alert for crop errors (238, 245, 251, 270), unlike photo-upload and passkey which unhide an inline error box; 238 and 245 also lack a period (COPY-06).
pattern=toasts-alerts Not a confirmation. Guide: notices are inline callouts. Code: window.alert("Please select a crop area before saving"), no closing period (COPY-06).
pattern=toasts-alerts Not a confirmation. Guide: notices are inline callouts. Code: window.alert for the gap check; sibling photo-upload shows the same kind of error in an inline error box.
pattern=toasts-alerts Not a confirmation. Guide: notices are inline callouts. Code: window.alert(`Error: ${error.message}`) for a failed save.

Guide: messages are whole sentences ending in a period. Code: "Please select an image" and "File must be less than N MB" (line 67) have none. Thumbnail built with innerHTML also carries shadow-xs (SHADOW-01).

Guide: everything works from the keyboard; tab_navigation wires the ARIA. Code: idle tabs get tabindex -1 (also tabs_helper.rb:102) but no arrow-key handler exists, so keyboard users cannot reach any tab but the active one.

Guide: motion is the approved set only, honouring reduced motion. Code: "show" triggers a 300ms slide-in/out (toasts.css toast-base) with no reduced-motion override. Durations and roles match TOAST-01 (6000ms, error stays).

Guide: collapsible content is ui_accordion or ui_disclosure (native <details>), long text read-more. Code: a JS disclosure toggling hidden/hidden! and aria-expanded, swapping the trigger's innerHTML label ("Hide Notes"), in 7 views.

Guide: confirm in the app dialog, asking with the action. Code: window.confirm("You have unsaved changes. Leaving this page will discard them. Continue?") on turbo:before-visit; beforeunload shows the browser's own prompt.

Guide: lg is the one structural fold. Code: width <= 768 or a mobile user agent swaps the picker for a native datetime-local input. Also builds a raw <button class="vc-close-btn"> (line 101), not ButtonHelper.
